title: A binomial coefficient is bounded by the corresponding power of two
statement: For all natural numbers n and k with k ≤ n, C(n, k) ≤ 2^n.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.choose_le_two_pow : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat.le x1 x0) -> AxNat.le (AxNat.choose x0 x1) (AxNat.pow (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) x0))))
